diagnosis.root_cause: The loop assembles a sliding force before the current linear solve and derives its magnitude from iterations.last().reactions. In a coupled fixture, that force changes u_x and therefore the newly solved normal reaction, but convergence is accepted as soon as the active-set state is unchanged. The returned friction force therefore remains mu times the prior normal rather than mu times the returned current normal.
